criticalFailures.q: Why is creatinine in different units?
criticalFailures.said: Your Creatinine result is 106 µmol/L, from 12 October 2026. That's within this lab's range of 62 to 115. Some general background: Creatinine is a waste product from muscles that the kidneys filter out, so it's used to check how the kidneys are working. Muscle mass, diet, activity and some medicines can affect it.
